story_scene: Level 1 (歐姆村, the first main-chapter battle) is gated on the jobBowMan /
jobThief / jobWingWarrior models (P-024); its STORY001 opening — the village
morning, 雷歐納德 and 琥, the raiders' approach from the south — is remade as a
preview that stops at first player control with a not-remade card.
Two named player installs (EVEF 雷歐納德 / 琥); STORY001 addresses them as
SID_雷歐納德 / SID_琥 rather than SID_PLAYERn.
actPlayLevelMusic at the end of the opening: table 0x477b44 gives level 1
After the not-remade battle the campaign continues on the big map at
歐姆村 (bigmap.dat point 1): the card exits to campaign.json's world_map
scene instead of restarting the prologue. The skipped level-1 battle
outcome (winfail001 win actions) is not applied — an explicit gap.
